content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD momentum source-term assembly (Simplified BSD header L1-44, FILE sources.F L3). Single SUBROUTINE SourceTerms (L56-489, history L48-53: Shi 2010, Tehranirad 2D Cd 2013, Choi viscosity breaking 2015, Shi conservative-form wavemaker fix 02/08/2016), USE GLOBAL plus VESSEL_MODULE (L58-60) and METEO_MODULE (L61-63) under prep flags. Part 1 wavemaker mass source (L84-148): for cells with |xmk-Xc_WK|<Width_WK and |ymk-Yc_WK|<Ywidth_WK/2 (L98-99; xmk/ymk use iista/jjsta offsets under PARALLEL, L91-92), fills WaveMaker_Mass: WK_REG single-frequency source with TANH time ramp, EXP(-Beta_gen*(xmk-Xc_WK)**2) shape, SIN(rlamda*y-2*PI/Tperiod*t) (L101-105); WK_IRR/TMA_1D/JON_1D/JON_2D sum over Nfreq of Cm*COS(OMGN_IR*t)+Sm*SIN(OMGN_IR*t) (L109-119); WK_TIME sum over NumWaveComp of D_genS(kf)*EXP(-Beta_genS(kf)*(xmk-Xc_WK)**2)*COS(2*PI/WAVE_COMP(kf,1)*t-WAVE_COMP(kf,3)) (L121-130); WK_DATA2D sum over NumFreq with OMGN2D (L132-143). Part 2 eddy viscosity field nu_vis (default-REAL array L66): =nu_break when VISCOSITY_BREAKING .OR. WAVEMAKER_VIS (L158-168), +=nu_sponge when DIFFUSION_SPONGE (L171-182). Part 3 main loop over Jbeg..Jend, Ibeg..Iend (L187-471) assembling SourceX/SourceY. CARTESIAN branch (L190-395): depth-gradient term GRAV*Eta/DX*(Depthx(I+1,J)-Depthx(I,J))*MASK (L193, second-order note L192); friction either Manning form -(GRAV*Cd**2/Max(H,MinDepthFrc)**(0.333333_SP))*U*|u| (L196-198) or quadratic -Cd*U*|u| (L200); Boussinesq dispersion source Gamma1*MASK9*Max(H,MinDepthFrc)*(u.grad(U4)+U4.grad(u)-Gamma2*MASK9*(U1pp+U2+U3)) (L205-209) plus Gamma1*MASK9*div(P,Q)*(U4-U1p) (L211-212); wavemaker momentum +WaveMaker_Mass*U (L214); optional FRICTION_SPONGE -CD_4_SPONGE*U*|u|*Depth (L216-221), WaveMakerCurrentBalance -WaveMakerCd*U*|u| inside maker box (L223-236), BREAKWATER -CD_breakwater*U*|u|*Depth (L238-243); SourceY mirror (L245-294); METEO WindForce adds MASK_WIND*RHO_AW*Cdw*WindU2D*|Wind| (L297-304); MIXING adds Smagorinsky nu_smg momentum diffusion on P,Q (L308-327); viscosity-breaking diffusion when VISCOSITY_BREAKING.OR.DIFFUSION_SPONGE.OR.WAVEMAKER_VIS (L335-395): PQ_scheme=.TRUE. path diffuses P/Q directly (L342-364) but PQ_scheme is hardcoded .FALSE. (L67) because P,Q are not exchanged at processor interfaces (comment L339-340), so the active path diffuses HU/HV (L367-390). Non-CARTESIAN branch (L396-468): SourceX=GRAV*Eta*SlopeX*MASK with same friction, dispersion via div(P,Q)/DX(I,J),DY(I,J) times (U4-U1p) under ZALPHA (L401-432) or times (-U1p) otherwise (L434-465), plus Coriolis +Coriolis*0.5*(Q(I,J)+Q(I,J+1)) for X (L415, L448) and -Coriolis*0.5*(P(I,J)+P(I+1,J)) for Y (L432, L465). Tail: VESSEL pressure gradients added unless VESSEL_PANEL_SOURCE (L473-480); METEO AirPressure adds StormPressureX/Y (L482-487). No file I/O executed (format 107 @L184 unused). Data blocks: none.

verbatim_spans.text: ! second order, move the second term to left-hand side
!      it turns out P and Q are not exchanged at processor interface

unresolved: PQ_scheme is hardcoded .FALSE. (L67); the P/Q-based viscous branch (L342-364) is dead code, kept with the explanation (L339-340) that P,Q are not exchanged at processor interfaces -- whether this remains true of the current EXCHANGE routines cannot be determined from this file.
Statement label 107 format(500f12.6) (L184) has no corresponding WRITE; INTEGER kd (L69) is declared but never used.
nu_vis is declared default-precision REAL (L66) while the arrays combined into it (nu_break, nu_sponge) and all other reals are REAL(SP) -- precision mixing if SP is double.
Coriolis terms exist only in the non-CARTESIAN branches (L415, L432, L448, L465); the CARTESIAN branch (L190-395) has no Coriolis -- asymmetry not explained in file.

Non-CARTESIAN dispersion factor differs by preprocessor flag: ZALPHA multiplies div(P,Q) by (U4-U1p)/(V4-V1p) (L413, L430) while the default multiplies by (-U1p)/(-V1p) (L446, L463); CARTESIAN uses (U4-U1p) (L212) -- relation of the three variants not stated.
WaveMaker_Mass is assigned only inside the wavemaker box (L98-145) and never zeroed outside it in this routine; cells leaving the box retain stale values unless initialized elsewhere (GLOBAL).
The wavemaker loop covers all cells 1..Nloc/1..Mloc including ghost cells (L84-85) while source assembly runs Jbeg..Jend/Ibeg..Iend (L187-188).

MANNING friction interprets Cd(I,J) as Manning n (GRAV*Cd**2/H**(1/3), L196-198) whereas the default branch interprets Cd as a drag coefficient (L200) -- same array, two meanings depending on compile flag.

Loop indices I,J and TIME, plus all forcing arrays (U1p,U1pp,U2,U3,V1p,V1pp,V2,V3,U4,V4,Cm,Sm,OMGN_IR,OMGN2D,D_gen,D_genS,Beta_gen,Beta_genS,rlamda,WAVE_COMP,CD_4_SPONGE,CD_breakwater,WaveMakerCd,nu_smg,Coriolis,SlopeX,SlopeY,VesselPressureX/Y,StormPressureX/Y,MASK_WIND,WindU2D/V2D,RHO_AW,Cdw) are module variables not declared here -- semantics depend on GLOBAL/VESSEL_MODULE/METEO_MODULE.
